text: Before the cameras arrive, the day begins with a call. Fame has a schedule, and it rarely waits.
A few quiet minutes and a cup of coffee. Then it is time to leave.
The hallway is quiet. Outside, that quiet will not last.
At the event, a familiar face draws attention. Phones rise, and strangers call his name.
Inside the studio, the conversation begins. Every appearance is another part of the job.
Between the cameras and the questions, there is a moment to greet someone who has waited to meet him.
The lights flash again. A wave is brief, but it matters to the people on the other side.
Later, the door closes and the noise fades. Behind the public image is a person who needs a little quiet too.
